### Overview

Visit Sri Lanka and book an amazing tour package with us. Sri Lanka is amazing tropical country in the world. Our drivers are well-knowledge English speaking professional tourist drivers. They love their role in Sri Lanka tourism and they always available to explore Sri Lanka with tourists around the world. Hire a personal driver with private car for your trip and enjoy the tour in Sri Lanka. This 5 days tour covers **[Kandy](https://srilankatoursdriver.com/ba_locations/kandy/),[Habarana](https://srilankatoursdriver.com/ba_locations/habarana/), Polonnaruwa, Pasikuda, Trincomalee, [Negombo](https://srilankatoursdriver.com/ba_locations/negombo/).

Vehicle Type:

1 - 3 Persons -\> Car

4 - 10 Persons -\> KDH Van

\*Minimum two persons are required

\* $680 for Two Persons - VIP Luxury Car (with Driver & Guiding)**

To book use one of easy option for you as mentioned below:

- Fill out the booking form
- Send an email to**[info@srilankatoursdriver.com](mailto:info@srilankatoursdriver.com)**
- Send WhatsApp message to **[(+94) 769 300 334](https://wa.me/+94769300334)**

### Included/Excluded

- Air-Conditioned Private Car
- English Speaking Professional Driver
- Driver's Accommodation & Meals
- Health and Safety Certificate
- Fuel
- Parking Fees
- 24 Hours Service
- Local Sim Card (Free Data)
- Water Bottles
- Freeway Tickets (Toll Road)

- Your Accommodation & Meals
- Entrance & Activities Fees

### Tour Plan

#### (All These Activities Depend Are On The Time You Spend On Each One)

#### Day 01

Pickup from Airport or Hotel at Colombo/Negombo & Drive to Kandy

- Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
- Kandy Lake
- Kandy Culture Show (5.30Pm to 6.30Pm)
- Temple of the Tooth Kandy (Ceremony starts at 7.00Pm)

Overnight stay at Kandy

These activities depend on your arrival time if pick up from airport.

#### Day 02

Pickup from Kandy at 7.00am & Drive to Habarana / On the way visit,

- Matale Hindu Temple
- Dambulla Cave Temple
- Dambulla Vegetable Market
- Village Tour with Sri Lankan Cooking Class & Sri Lankan Lunch
- Eco Park Safari or Pidurangala Sunset (Choose an option)

Overnight stay at Habarana

#### Day 03

Pickup from Habarana at 7.00am & Drive to Pasikuda/ On the way visit,

- Sigiriya Rock Fortress
- Polonnaruwa Ancient Kingdom
- Pasikuda Beach (Kalkudah Beach)

Overnight stay at Pasikuda

#### Day 04

Pickup from Pasikuda at 7.00am & Drive to Trincomalee / On the way visit,

- Marble Beach
- Koneswaram Temple
- Fort Fredrick
- Pigeon Island National Park
- Nilaveli Beach

Overnight stay at Trincomalee

#### Day 05

Pick Up From Trincomalee at 7am & Drive to Airport or Hotel at Negombo / Colombo

- Negombo Lagoon Tour or
- Colombo City Tour

(Choose an option)

Drop at Bandaranaike International Airport or Hotel at Negombo / Colombo

### Overview

Visit Sri Lanka and book an amazing tour package with us. Sri Lanka is amazing tropical country in the world. Our drivers are well-knowledge English speaking professional tourist drivers. They love their role in Sri Lanka tourism and they always available to explore Sri Lanka with tourists around the world. Hire a personal driver with private car for your trip and enjoy the tour in Sri Lanka. This 10 days tour covers **[Negombo](https://srilankatoursdriver.com/ba_locations/negombo/), [Ella](https://srilankatoursdriver.com/ba_locations/ella/), [Nuwara Eliya](https://srilankatoursdriver.com/ba_locations/nuwara-eliya/),[Kandy](https://srilankatoursdriver.com/ba_locations/kandy/),[Habarana](https://srilankatoursdriver.com/ba_locations/habarana/), Polonnaruwa, Pasikuda, Trincomalee.

Vehicle Type:

1 - 3 Persons -\> Car

4 - 10 Persons -\> KDH Van

\*Minimum two persons are required

\* $1580 for Two Persons - VIP Luxury Car (with Driver & Guiding) & Star Hotel with Breakfast**

To book use one of easy option for you as mentioned below:

- Fill out the booking form
- Send an email to**[info@srilankatoursdriver.com](mailto:info@srilankatoursdriver.com)**
- Send WhatsApp message to **[(+94) 769 300 334](https://wa.me/+94769300334)**

### Included/Excluded

- Air-Conditioned Private Vehicle
- English Speaking Professional Driver
- Accommodation with Breakfast
- Driver's Accommodation & Meals
- Health and Safety Certificate
- Fuel
- Parking Fees
- 24 Hours Emergency Service
- Local Sim Card (Free Data)
- Water Bottles
- Freeway Tickets (Toll Road)

- Entrance & Activities Fees
- Train Ticket(s)

### Tour Plan

#### (All These Activities Depend Are On The Time You Spend On Each One)

#### Day 01

Pickup from Airport or Hotel at Colombo/Negombo

- Negombo Fish Market
- Negombo Dutch Fort
- Negombo Lagoon Tour

Overnight stay at New Queen's Palace - Negombo (With Swimming Pool)

These activities depend on your arrival time if pick up from airport.

#### Day 02

Pickup from Negombo at 7.00am & Drive to Ella / On the way visit,

- Kithulgala Water Rafting
- Ravana Waterfall
- Little Adam’s Peak
- Demodara Nine Arch Bridge

Overnight stay at Sunray Homestay - Ella

#### Day 03

Pickup from Ella at 6.00am & Drive to Kandy / On the way visit,

- Train Journey Ella to Nanu Oya (One of the most beautiful train ride in the world known as "Blue Train Journey")
- Victoria Park
- Walking City Tour in Nuwara Eliya
- Gregory Lake
- Pedro Tea Estate
- Seetha Amman Kovil

Overnight stay at Lu Chalet - Nuwara Eliya

#### Day 04

Pickup from Nuwara Eliya at 5.00am & Drive to Kandy / On the way visit,

- Horton Plains National Park (Gate opens at 6am)
- Baker's Waterfall
- Ambewela Farm
- Ramboda Falls
- Glenloch Tea Factory and Tea Center
- Kandy Lake
- Kandy Culture Show (5.30pm to 6.30pm)
- Temple of the Tooth Kandy (Ceremony starts at 7.00pm)

Overnight stay at Jack Tree Lodge - Kandy

#### Day 05

Pickup from Kandy at 7.00am & Drive to Habarana / On the way visit,

- Matale Hindu Temple
- Dambulla Cave Temple
- Dambulla Vegetable Market
- Hiriwadunna Village Tour with Sri Lankan Cooking Class & Sri Lankan Lunch
- Wild Safari at Eco Park or Pidurangala Sunset (Choose an option)

Overnight stay at Go Go Green - Habarana (With Swimming Pool)

#### Day 06

Pickup from Habarana at 7.00am & Drive to Pasikuda / On the way visit,

- Sigiriya Rock Fortress
- Polonnaruwa Ancient Kingdom
- Pasikuda Beach (Kalkudah Beach)

Overnight stay at Pasikuda

#### Day 07

- Water Sports
- Beach Leisure
- Batticaloa Fort
- New Kallady Bridge Batticaloa
- Batticaloa Lighthouse

Overnight stay at Pasikuda

#### Day 08

Pickup from Pasikuda at 7.00am & Drive to Trincomalee / On the way visit,

- Marble Beach
- British War Cemetery
- Uppuveli Trincomalee
- Fort Fredrick

Overnight stay at Trincomalee

#### Day 09

- Pigeon Island National Park
- Nilaveli Beach
- Koneswaram Temple

Overnight stay at Trincomalee

#### Day 10

Pick Up From Trincomalee at 7am & Drive to Airport or Hotel at Negombo / Colombo

- Colombo City Tour (You can decide to do or not)

Drop at Bandaranaike International Airport or Hotel at Negombo / Colombo

These activities depend on your departure time if drop off at airport.

### Last Minute Deals

Book Now
